reviews.author: Eddy Oquendo
reviews.text: Dropped in at Kava for chess a few times — all the way from Orlando! It’s just a fun time, with some great energy from the members of the club and the venue itself. I’ll never get tired of visiting. Looking forward to my next time!

reviews.author: Samantha Julien
reviews.text: I play chess here once a week on Sundays, and the group is great. They have cheap alternatives since I can’t drink kava or kratom, and the people are great to be around. Everyone is friendly, and they always have some kind of event going on.

reviews.author: Alex Galante
reviews.text: Solid chess club with relaxed, beginner-friendly vibes and good organization/leadership.

reviews.author: Matthew Saba
reviews.text: Good drinks and good people, always a fun time.

reviews.author: Josh Silvani
reviews.text: Amazing chess club and great group of people. The club itself has a large amount of events happening regularly through the year and is active with players of all levels all year round, rain or shine, hot or cold.  Harold, the director of this chess club, is constantly working on improving the club, putting on events, and even keeps track of entire seasons of weekly tournaments with chess member having an in house elo system.

reviews.author: Diego Davila
reviews.text:
This Kava social club is easily one of the most unique and laid-back spots I’ve been to. The vibe is relaxed but alive, the kava is smooth and well-crafted, and the staff genuinely care about creating a welcoming space. It’s the kind of place where conversations flow just as easily as the drinks.

What really sets this place apart, though, is the chess club. Hands down the coolest chess scene around. You’ll find players of every level—from casual thinkers to serious strategists—and everyone is respectful, competitive, and encouraging. Games spark real conversations, friendly rivalries, and a sense of community you don’t find often anymore.

Whether you come for a quiet evening, a deep chess match, or just to meet interesting people in a calm, positive environment, this place delivers every time. If you’re into kava, community, or chess—or all three—this spot is an absolute must-visit.
